packageRules.description: go.mod's replace pins kustomize to the version kustomize-controller pins. Newer kustomize needs a k8s.io/kube-openapi built on sigs.k8s.io/structured-merge-diff/v7, which k8s.io/apimachinery v0.37 cannot use. Re-enable together with the replace, once k8s.io moves to structured-merge-diff/v7.
